lines.text: Twenty-three people arrived at 4am this morning. The queue outside now extends past the coconut tree and around the corner. Nandadasa has been fielding questions since 4:12am. He is not amused. He is being thorough, which in this context is indistinguishable from not being amused.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: A message was circulating. 4am voting. It was false. Polling is at 7am. It has always been at 7am. I processed forty phone calls before my morning tea.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: Registration closes today. If your form is not submitted today, it cannot be accepted.

lines.prompt: Have you submitted your registration form?

choices.label: Submit the completed ER-1 form now.
I have not registered yet. Can I still do it?
